unlaned_tests.reason: Deliberate: a fixture GENERATOR with disk side effects, not an assertion. It is invoked explicitly by tests/runtime/prepare_synthetic_assets.py, never by a CI lane, and run_module_tests.py already excludes [GeneratePLY] from the untagged safety net for that reason. Recorded here so the exclusion is declared in a machine-readable place rather than only in a code comment. Originally catalogued under #520, which is now CLOSED; re-pointed to its live successor #819 so the declaration is not blessed by a dead tracking issue.

MEASURED, no longer undecided. [Thumbnail] is listed in UNTAGGED_GAUSSIAN_EXCLUDE_TAGS but no [Thumbnail] lane was ever defined, so both cases in test_gaussian_importer.h are excluded from the only lane that would have run them. Named in #520's title (#520 is now CLOSED). Of the 2 stranded cases, 'Generator produces preview images for each style' PASSES and 'Generator caches deterministic asset+settings keys' is a confirmed FAILURE at modules/gaussian_splatting/tests/test_gaussian_importer.h:1181, where CHECK(misses >= 2) reports CHECK( 0 >= 2 ) after three generate_thumbnail_image calls - reproduced at e9ddb27c285 and again on a binary 22 commits older, per https://github.com/klausi3D/godotGS/issues/814, which now tracks this declaration. It cannot move to 'entries' until [Thumbnail] has a lane (#819): an entry names a MODULE_TEST_FILTERS lane and the harness fails a quarantined lane that does not actually run and fail, so this declaration records non-execution, not disposition-of-failure.

PARTIALLY ADDRESSED by #641, which added the GPU-harness 'Integration' batch matching '*Integration*][RequiresGPU]*'. These nine cases carry no [RequiresGPU] tag, so that batch does not reach them and neither does any module lane. #641 fixed the tagged subset and left this one dark.

The headline orphan of #520. run_module_tests.py excludes '*][World][SceneTree]*' from the [SceneTree] lane, which reads as de-duplication against a [World] lane, but no [World] lane exists. The neighbouring [Node]/[Container] exclusions DO dedupe against real lanes, which camouflaged this one. 3 of the 7 carry no [RequiresGPU]; the other 4 were previously credited to the opt-in [requires-RD] catalogue, which blocking CI never runs - so they looked laned while being just as invisible (Codex, PR #658). Adding a strict [World] lane is the fix for the 3, and the 4 need a GPU harness batch; both need a proven-green run. #520 is CLOSED; re-pointed to its live successor #819.

unlaned_tests.test_case: [RendererSceneCull] Hidden indexing policy gates Gaussian exemption
unlaned_tests.reason: Gaussian-relevant but lives in the ENGINE test tree (tests/servers/rendering/test_renderer_scene_cull.h), and carries no [GaussianSplatting] tag, so no module lane or GPU batch reaches it. It asserts RendererSceneCull::allows_hidden_visibility_indexing gates the INSTANCE_GAUSSIAN_SPLAT exemption - a real contract on our engine delta. Surfaced only after this guard's corpus scan was widened to the engine tree recursively; a tag-filtered, top-level-only scan missed it. Fix is a lane that reaches gaussian-relevant engine-tree cases, which needs a proven-green run. #520 is CLOSED; re-pointed to its live successor #819.

Named split of the former 59-case '*][RequiresGPU]*' catch-all (T4, ADR section 5.4; #820 superseded). LAST declaration by design: attribution is first-match, so after the narrower #907/#910 declarations above claim their 17 cases, this anchored bare-tag-pair pattern attributes exactly the 38 bare-tagged cases of test_renderer_pipeline.h, enumerated one by one in #906 - the largest single-file share of the split (38 of its 56 cases). A NEW bare-tagged stranded case makes this declaration over-matched and fails the guard loudly. Exit (#906): retag into subsystem batches - a move into the required RendererPipeline batch needs the ADR section 5.5 proven-green evidence first - shrinking this count with each proven move.
